title: Library of Congress Classification (LCC), MDSConnect MARCXML classification records (2016 retrospective)
publisher: Library of Congress, Cataloging Distribution Service
perspective: US Library of Congress (national library, USA); a shelf classification grown from LC's own collection
license: No cost; MDSConnect sets are 'designated primarily for research, education and development use'; 'we encourage you to use the data for research, educational and development purposes' and attribution to LC is appreciated (MDSConnect FAQ)
update: Static retrospective set (2016; Last-Modified 2019-06-21); FAQ 'anticipate annual updates' but none posted; current LCC only in Classification Web (subscription) or as free PDF schedules (data selected May 2024)
notes: id.loc.gov offers NO bulk LC Classification download (its /download/ page lists none; the 'LCC A...Z' files there are experimental Amazon Titan vector embeddings grouped by LCC class letter, not the schedules). This file is the MARC 21 Classification format in MARCXML (namespace http://www.loc.gov/MARC21/slim, one <record> per number, leader type w): 153 $a number or span, repeatable $h = captions of the hierarchy above, $j = caption; also 680 scope notes, 683 instructions, 253/353 see/see-also references, 453/553 number tracings, 753 index terms, 761-763 table instructions (tags counted in the first 4,342 records). No parent pointer: rebuild the tree from the $h chain and number ranges. Same page lists a UTF-8 MARC twin (Class.2016.part01.utf8.gz, 29,879,560 bytes) and a 2014 set. 'no' because it is ten years stale, needs a MARC-classification parser, and the FAQ wording limits the intended use; the repo already holds LCC top classes. Free current PDFs: https://www.loc.gov/aba/publications/FreeLCC/freelcc.html (not machine-readable).

notes: Zenodo archive of github.com/iconclass/data (folder iconclass-data-99f94ab; md5 3c9566ee8c2a15a8aa377df9f33c512b in the Zenodo record matched my download). Custom text format, not RDF: notations.txt = records separated by lines '$', fields 'N <notation>', 'C <child>' (more values on following lines starting '; '), also 'K' (keys) and 'R' fields; labels in txt/<lang>/txt_<lang>_<range>.txt as 'notation|label' lines for de, en, es, fi, fr, hu, it, jp (non-standard code for Japanese), nl, pl, pt, zh; keywords in kw/<lang>/ (9 languages); keys.txt defines the '(+..)' key sub-trees that expand ~40k base nodes to over a million; bracketed '(...)' notations are open name slots (e.g. 11H(...) male saints). Per-notation SKOS by URI (http://iconclass.org/<notation>.rdf or .jsonld) but no official full SKOS dump. For current data use https://github.com/iconclass/data (notations.txt 1,518,830 bytes verified via raw.githubusercontent.com; github.com archive endpoints were blocked by this session's policy). Strong Christian/Classical skew by design (European art) - useful exactly as a declared perspective.
